---

This PR makes the event guard reject events that carry no signature, and adds a test for that rejection. You are the author. No spec or ticket is linked, so the PR's own description is what it promises, and both the rejection behavior and its test are in place.

One problem blocks merging, and the last repair attempt could not fix it. The guard compares signatures with ordinary equality (src/guard.ts:18). That kind of comparison can reveal, through response timing, how much of a forged signature is correct, and the repository's review rules require a constant-time comparison.

The repair switched to the chosen constant-time compare helper. That helper still falls back to ordinary equality, so the test "signature comparison is constant-time" in src/guard.test.ts failed and the change was undone. The branch is exactly as it was before the attempt.

The required CI check passed, but it only covers rejecting unsigned events, not how signatures are compared. Repeating the same repair would fail the same way. Progress needs a different comparison approach, for example calling Node's `timingSafeEqual` directly instead of the chosen helper.

I recommend stop because no remaining option can change the outcome until the comparison approach changes.

Pick one:
1. stop - remove the worktree at .worktrees/pr-642 and leave the PR and its branch as they are. [recommended]
2. deliver - continue the repair work, allowing six more repair attempts and six more branch updates. It retries the fix only once the comparison approach has changed; otherwise it stops at this same point.
3. assess - post the constant-time comparison problem to the PR as a review comment and make no repairs.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
